references.text: The prediction that the Egyptians would not be able to drink water from the Nile, which is now fulfilled in verse 24.
A description of how all the water in Egypt turned to blood, explaining why the Egyptians had to dig for water.
The psalmist recalls how God turned rivers into blood so that the Egyptians could not drink.
A poetic retelling of how God turned Egypt's waters into blood and killed their fish.
John's Revelation describes a similar plague where the sea and rivers turn to blood, echoing the plagues in Egypt.
The third bowl of wrath turns rivers and water sources into blood, a parallel to Egypt's first plague.
